description: Human proteome null distribution of N-terminal hydrophobic moment, to test how unusual the AP3D1 value is
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, math
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
EIS=dict(A=.62,R=-2.53,N=-.78,D=-.90,C=.29,Q=-.85,E=-.74,G=.48,H=-.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,K=-1.50,
         M=.64,F=1.19,P=.12,S=-.18,T=-.05,W=.81,Y=.26,V=1.08)
def muH(seq,angle=100.):
    s=[a for a in seq if a in EIS]; n=len(s)
    if n<8: return np.nan
    th=np.deg2rad(np.arange(n)*angle); h=np.array([EIS[a] for a in s])
    return math.hypot((h*np.cos(th)).sum(),(h*np.sin(th)).sum())/n
u=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
    params={"query":"reviewed:true AND organism_id:9606","format":"fasta"},timeout=900)
print("stream status",u.status_code,"bytes",len(u.text))
seqs=[];cur=[]
for ln in u.text.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith(">"):
        if cur: seqs.append("".join(cur))
        cur=[]
    else: cur.append(ln.strip())
if cur: seqs.append("".join(cur))
seqs=[s for s in seqs if len(s)>=24]
print("human reviewed proteins length>=24:",len(seqs))
n14=np.array([muH(s[:14]) for s in seqs]); n24=np.array([muH(s[:24]) for s in seqs])
n14=n14[~np.isnan(n14)]; n24=n24[~np.isnan(n24)]
for lbl,arr,val in [("first 14 aa",n14,0.4642),("first 24 aa",n24,0.4207)]:
    print(f"{lbl}: n={len(arr)} median {np.median(arr):.3f} | p75 {np.percentile(arr,75):.3f} | "
          f"p90 {np.percentile(arr,90):.3f} | p95 {np.percentile(arr,95):.3f} | p99 {np.percentile(arr,99):.3f} "
          f"|| AP3D1 {val:.3f} -> percentile {(arr<val).mean()*100:.1f} (empirical P(muH>=obs) = {(arr>=val).mean():.3f})")
# where do the benchmark helices fall in this null?
bm={"epsin1 H0 (1-18)":0.3954,"ArfGAP1 ALPS1":0.3836,"GMAP210 ALPS":0.3206,"Sar1A 1-23":0.3275,
    "amphiphysin1 H0":0.3099,"ApoA-I class A":0.4177,"AP2A1 1-24":0.1970,"AP1G1 1-24":0.2726}
print("\npercentile of benchmarks against the human 'first 24 aa' null:")
for k,v in bm.items(): print(f"  {k:22s} muH {v:.3f} -> {(n24<v).mean()*100:5.1f}th percentile")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.hist(n24,bins=80,color="#BDC3C7",edgecolor="none",label="human reviewed proteome, first 24 aa (n=%d)"%len(n24))
for k,v,c in [("AP3D1 1-24",0.4207,"#C0392B"),("ApoA-I class A (surface-binding)",0.4177,"#B7950B"),
              ("epsin1 H0 (inserting)",0.3954,"#2E86C1"),("AP2A1 1-24 (paralog control)",0.1970,"#7F8C8D")]:
    ax.axvline(v,color=c,lw=2,label=f"{k}: {v:.3f} ({(n24<v).mean()*100:.0f}th pct)")
ax.set_xlabel("hydrophobic moment per residue, Eisenberg consensus, 100 deg/residue")
ax.set_ylabel("number of human proteins")
ax.set_title("A high N-terminal hydrophobic moment is common by chance:\nAP3D1 sits near the 90th percentile of all human protein N-termini")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.2)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
